mesh_derivation.declaration: the FE mesh is a 2D plane-stress radial O-grid over the mid-plane domain [-a,a]x[-b,b] with the central hole r — DERIVED from the same parameters as the CadQuery solid (an idealization declared here; the STEP export is the engineering artifact of record)

step_export.note: STEP headers carry export timestamps; the geometry_hash pins the canonical params + engineering checks (deterministic), the step sha is informational

boundary_conditions.load_model: uniform edge traction (engineering convention) on x=+a; both the projection and tilt misalignment readings
boundary_conditions.constraints: u_x=0 on x=-a (left edge); u_y anchored at one node (rigid-body removal)
boundary_conditions.free_surfaces: top/bottom edges and the hole (stress-concentrator) boundary
